```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)

titanic <- as.data.frame(Titanic)

labels_ca <- list(
  Class = c("1a classe", "2a classe", "3a classe", "Tripulació"),
  Sex = c("Homes", "Dones"),
  Survived = c("No", "Sí")
)

titanic$Class <- factor(titanic$Class, levels = c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "Crew"), labels = labels_ca$Class)
titanic$Sex <- factor(titanic$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"), labels = labels_ca$Sex)
titanic$Survived <- factor(titanic$Survived, levels = c("No", "Yes"), labels = labels_ca$Survived)

fig <- ggplot(
  titanic,
  aes(y = Freq, axis1 = Class, axis2 = Sex, axis3 = Survived)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Class), width = 1 / 12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1 / 12, fill = "#d8e1e6", color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_label(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3.2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Classe", "Sexe", "Supervivència"),
    expand = c(0.08, 0.08)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "1a classe" = "#2171b5",
      "2a classe" = "#4292c6",
      "3a classe" = "#9ecae1",
      "Tripulació" = "#d3dce0"
    )
  ) +
  ggtitle("Passatgers del Titanic per classe, sexe i supervivència") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "#17202a"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/alluvial-titanic-demo.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 9, height = 6, device = svglite::svglite)
```
